mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_ticket_bug_metrics ( ticket_bug_id, project_id, repository_id, ticket_id, internal_bug_count, customer_bug_count, note, status, delete_flag, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by ) VALUES ( #{ticketBugId}, #{projectId}, #{repositoryId}, #{ticketId}, #{internalBugCount}, #{customerBugCount}, #{note}, #{status}::record_status, #{deleteFlag}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy} )
